envelope.text: Returns by VALUE where upstream hands

why: RE-VERDICTED 2026-10-27 (phase-515 P3), was `declined`/`absent` ("hands out the underlying DDS-shaped profile so a caller can bypass the API"): issue 2054 shipped it, so the row described an API that no longer existed -- found by the new `misdeclared_absences` check. It correlates `same:ret`. ENVELOPE: it returns the profile BY VALUE where upstream returns a reference to its stored struct, because `QoS` stores the C ABI's fields, not upstream's; a ported read (`auto p = qos.get_rmw_qos_profile();`) is unchanged, and a write through the result does not compile.
